full_details: After midnight you were still on the palace side of the green, and you took the walk to the inn without a song and without the button story. In the morning you kept prayer at the long table. It is a year to the day since the two Errors, and this was the one Sunday. You gave Egeon's long tale to a hall with cups in its hands, stood behind the traverse while they laughed, and spent the second act finding a roll in Garnish's chest. My lord left the jig. Nick came in on the note because he was happy. The voice dropped out and came back a fifth lower. He stopped, bowed, and Arthur took the next verse. You told him it had come. The two cloaks stayed for a morning count. Kemp's story stayed for an inn that is not this one.
one_sentence: You kept morning prayer at the inn, played the old comedy before the Queen, and heard a boy's voice come back a man's in the jig.
title: Nick's voice came back a fifth lower
